audit_result.proof_trace: The `completeRegistration` function reads `is_used` (L243) and then writes `is_used=true` (L267) without a database transaction or `SELECT FOR UPDATE` lock, creating a TOCTOU race. Two concurrent requests holding the same token can both pass the `is_used == false` check before either commits the update, violating the single-use invariant. The `attendance.users.card_id` unique constraint provides a partial mitigation (prevents double-registration) but does not prevent a racing attacker from winning the card binding.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker photographs the kiosk QR code and races the legitimate user: both submit `completeRegistration` concurrently; both pass the `is_used=false` check in the same time window; the attacker's upsert succeeds first, linking the scanned card to the attacker's Discord account; the legitimate user's subsequent upsert fails with a unique constraint violation, locking them out of their own card.

PROP-0000-create-pre-003.text: temp_registrations must enforce single-use: is_used=true tokens must not be reusable.
PROP-0000-create-pre-003.assertion: forall t: use_registration(t) => t.is_used == false AND t.expires_at > now()
